title: Grand Theft Auto IV: The Complete Edition
provenance: Reported by Bipolaire (highball-db#108, 2026-09-17), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 27.2 as entered, Highball 0.9.19, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r3, Wine's Direct3D, rated 4 of 5 (playable, minor issues) after 55 minutes. Michael-Liendo (highball-db#280, 2026-10-02), Apple M4, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.10.2, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r17, the environment on DXVK, rated 4 of 5 after 60 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer. Yas1ne (highball-db#853, 2026-11-01), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-crossover26.3-r9, WineD3D by the report (the environment's mode is DXMT), rated 5 of 5 after 1 minutes: a one minute look. ake6ck (highball-db#969, 2026-11-04), Apple M5, macOS 26.6, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-crossover26.3-r29, DXVK by the report (the environment's mode is DXMT), rated 3 of 5 after 9 minutes: usually smooth with frequent stutters. It only booted once installed in the environment that has the Rockstar Games Launcher (recipes rockstar, steam and vcrun2022), with DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1 set. HaxproLegend (highball-db#1285, 2026-11-17), Apple M5, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-crossover26.3-r31, DXVK by the report (the environment's mode is DXMT), rated 4 of 5 after 11 minutes: a 60 fps cap and a dinput8=n,b DLL override, after many tweaks the player doesn't list. Played to the first mission through all the cutscenes at a steady 60 fps, with black squares glitching in and out across the screen now and then. philipusGood (highball-db#1400, 2026-11-22), Apple M4, macOS 26.7.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-crossover26.3-r31, DXVK by the report (the environment's mode is DXMT), rated 4 of 5 after 113 minutes: the Steam copy on a 16 GB MacBook Air with the lid closed and a 2560x1080 LG ultrawide, with the steam, vcrun2022 and rockstar recipes and DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1. The setup that works, in the player's words: DXVK as the game's mode with the launch argument -availablevidmem 4000, the Rockstar Games Launcher installed in a separate environment, which fixed 'Failed to initialize Rockstar Games Launcher' and a SocialClubHelper crash, the Steam overlay off for the game, 2560x1080 at 50 Hz with VSync on in the game (at 100 Hz VSync gave uneven pacing and sluggish movement), and Emulate display mode changes off. Black line segments flicker with every mode, less at the native resolution. Changing graphics settings in the game can crash or black out the screen, and a 16:9 mode on the 21:9 monitor gave a black screen at every start until SETTINGS.CFG was deleted. The macOS cursor stayed visible beside the game's, setting off hot corners, until CaptureDisplaysForFullscreen was set to y under HKCU\Software\Wine\Mac Driver. With DXVK the start now and then hangs (SocialClubHelper looping on a D3D11 QueryInterface, then Steam's 'BMainLoop stalled'), and stopping and starting again works.
notes: Reported playable twice: 55 minutes on Wine's own Direct3D (M4 Pro, engine r3) and 60 minutes on an M4 with the environment on DXVK (engine r17). The second report saw black line segments flicker in a grid across the picture on Wine's Direct3D, which the game's Definition and Shadow settings did not change, brief stutter when turning the camera until -availablevidmem 4000 was added to the game's launch options, and a DualSense that the game only saw after the two WineBus values Highball's Controllers through SDL tweak sets. The row now points at DXVK, the mode of the longer and more detailed report, for a 2008 Direct3D 9 game. Needs the Rockstar Games Launcher for sign-in on Steam. A 9 minute report on an M5 with the CrossOver based engine rated it playable with workarounds, usually smooth with frequent stutters, once it was installed in the environment that has the Rockstar Games Launcher. No measurement here yet. An M5 played it to the first mission at a steady 60 fps on the Wine 11 engine r31, DXVK by the report, with black squares glitching in and out now and then (highball-db#1285).

knownIssues.symptom: Black line segments in a grid pattern flicker across the picture in play on Wine's Direct3D (reported on an M4, engine r17). A player on an M4 saw them with every mode, Wine's Direct3D, DXMT and DXVK, much reduced at the native resolution but not gone (highball-db#1400)
knownIssues.cause: Not investigated here. The game's Definition and Shadow settings do not change it
knownIssues.fix: Set the game's graphics mode to DXVK, where the same reporter played an hour. Another player saw them in DXVK too, much reduced at the native resolution (highball-db#1400)

knownIssues.symptom: Brief stutter when moving the camera (reported on an M4, engine r17)
knownIssues.cause: Not investigated here. The game budgets video memory from what the driver reports
knownIssues.fix: The reporter added -availablevidmem 4000 to the game's launch options in Steam and the stutter stopped. Not applied by the row, one report so far

knownIssues.symptom: A DualSense controller is not seen by the game (reported on an M4)
knownIssues.cause: Wine's controller driver reads the pad through the Mac's raw HID path as well as SDL, and some games only see it through SDL
knownIssues.fix: Apply the Controllers through SDL tweak from the environment's recipes (it sets Enable SDL and DisableHidraw under HKCU\Software\Wine\WineBus, the two values the reporter set by hand), then restart the environment

knownIssues.symptom: Black squares glitch in and out across the screen now and then (M5, DXVK by the report, Wine 11 r31, highball-db#1285)
Changing graphics settings in the game can crash it or black out the screen, and a 16:9 mode on a 21:9 monitor gave a black screen at every start (M4, Wine 11 r31, highball-db#1400)
knownIssues.fix: delete SETTINGS.CFG to get back in, then change one setting at a time and restart, by the reporter

knownIssues.symptom: The macOS cursor stays visible beside the game's and sets off hot corners (M4, Wine 11 r31, highball-db#1400)
knownIssues.fix: set CaptureDisplaysForFullscreen to y (a string) under HKCU\Software\Wine\Mac Driver in the environment's registry, by the reporter

knownIssues.symptom: With DXVK the start now and then hangs, SocialClubHelper looping on a D3D11 QueryInterface and then Steam's 'BMainLoop stalled' (M4, Wine 11 r31, highball-db#1400)
knownIssues.fix: stop the game and start it again, by the reporter
